faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the District Court Kabirdham Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the District Court Kabirdham Recruitment 2026 is 12 August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What are the eligibility criteria for the posts released by District Court Kabirdham?
faq.answer: Candidates must be graduates from a recognized university and possess a one-year computer diploma. Knowledge of Hindi and English typing on a computer, along with proficiency in the local Chhattisgarhi language, is also required.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: A total of 10 vacancies are available for the posts of Execution Clerk, Evidence Writer, and Order Writer in the District Court Kabirdham.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applying to these posts?
faq.answer: The age limit for applicants is between 18 years and 30 years. Age relaxations are applicable as per Chhattisgarh government rules for specific categories.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the recruited candidates?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a salary in Pay Matrix Level 04, ranging from Rs. 19,500 to Rs. 62,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the District Court Kabirdham Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Written Test followed by a Skill Test. Candidates must qualify in both stages to be considered for the final selection.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for the District Court Kabirdham Recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. Candidates need to download the application form from the official website, fill it correctly, attach necessary documents, and send it to the address specified in the notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q9. What documents are required to be submitted with the application form?
faq.answer: Candidates are required to attach self-attested copies of necessary documents, including a photograph, signature, ID proof, and educational/technical qualification certificates, as mentioned in the official notification.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of the District Court Kabirdham, which is https://kabirdham.dcourts.gov.in/. Links are also provided in the "Important Links" section of this article.
